name: Timeline
when_to_pick: Walk the reader through a sequenced process with phases. Set orientation='vertical' (default) for a stacked list that holds longer bodies and a marker per step — best for rollouts, multi-week plans, or step-by-step procedures; the last step can be toned 'danger'/'warning' to call out kill-criteria / stop conditions. Set orientation='horizontal' for a compact left-to-right band of 3-6 short phases that read as a flow (e.g. a trading day: premarket -> London open -> NY close); keep titles and bodies short in this mode. For discrete numbered actions (do this, then that) use how_it_works_steps; for branching logic use decision-tree.

orientation.description: Layout direction. 'vertical' (default) stacks steps top-to-bottom and supports a per-step marker plus longer bodies. 'horizontal' lays 3-6 short phases left-to-right as a flow band; keep titles <= ~40 chars and bodies <= ~160 chars in this mode.

marker.description: Short marker text shown in the circle. If omitted, the step's position (1, 2, 3, ...) is used.
